verses.text: Joshua got up early, and he and all the Israelites left Shittim and came to the Jordan. They camped there before crossing.
After three days, the officers went through the camp.
They told the people, “When you see the Levitical priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, leave where you are and follow it.
Keep about two thousand cubits between you and the ark. Don't get any closer. That way you'll see where to go, since you've never been this way before.”
Joshua told the people, “Set yourselves apart for God, because tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
Joshua told the priests, “Pick up the ark of the covenant and cross ahead of the people.” They picked it up and went ahead of everyone.
The LORD told Joshua, “Today I'll begin to honor you in front of all Israel, so they'll know that I'm with you just as I was with Moses.
Tell the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan, step into the river and stand still.’”
Joshua told the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
He said, “Here's how you'll know that the living God is among you and will certainly drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites ahead of you.
Look, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is going into the Jordan ahead of you.
Now select twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man from each tribe.

When the feet of the priests carrying the ark of God, the Lord of all the earth, come to rest in the Jordan, the river's flow will be cut off. The water coming from upstream will pile up in one place.”
The people left their tents to cross the Jordan, with the priests carrying the ark of the covenant out in front.
The Jordan floods its banks throughout harvest season. When the priests carrying the ark reached the river and their feet touched the water at the edge,

the water coming from upstream stopped and backed up far away at Adam, the town near Zarethan. The flow down to the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, was cut off completely. So the people crossed near Jericho.
The priests carrying the ark of the LORD's covenant stood firmly on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan. All Israel crossed on dry ground until the whole nation was across.
